name: Contacting The Dead
overview: Scripture clearly forbids seeking contact with the dead or consulting those with familiar spirits, warning that such practices defile believers and provoke God's judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6; Deuteronomy 18:9). The Bible teaches that the dead do not praise the Lord nor possess knowledge or thoughts, as their breath has departed and their memory fades (Psalms 115:17; 146:4; Ecclesiastes 9:5). Therefore, turning to the dead or engaging in necromancy is both futile and contrary to God's design for life and worship.
